name: 30643 · Hartwell, GA
findings: ZIP 30643 (Hartwell) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30643 (Hartwell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30643 (Hartwell) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30643 (Hartwell) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
